description: Convert Swiss LV95 coordinates (EPSG:2056, easting ~2'600'000 / northing ~1'200'000) to WGS84 latitude/longitude. LV03 legacy values (600'000/200'000 range) are auto-detected and shifted. Swapped easting/northing and out-of-range values are rejected with an explanation.
name: convert_lv95_to_wgs84
title: Convert LV95 → WGS84
